art_instructions: A sunny, cheerful scene in the front yard of the cozy cottage: creamy white walls with sage‑green shutters and a warm terracotta roof visible in the background, with a short cobblestone path curving into the grass and beds of sunflowers and lavender along the edges. Use a wide, eye‑level view so all four friends are clearly seen playing with one red‑and‑white striped ball in the center. Panda stands at the left foreground, mid‑step with a big smile, arms open as if he has just tapped the ball toward the others. Slightly behind Panda near the lavender, Koala (wearing her leaf‑green scarf) claps happily with a gentle grin; her tiny acorn‑brown backpack rests on the grass beside her. On the right foreground, the small green Dinosaur with a pale mint belly leans forward with arms wide, ready to receive the ball; his little red backpack is on his back and his expression is bright and excited. Owl is just above the grass at center‑right in a low glide, green scarf visible, lightly batting the ball back with the edge of her wing, eyes joyful. Include the small tree on the left that earlier had a mouse beneath it, now quiet and empty, emphasizing that everyone is calm and rejoicing as they play again; keep lighting bright with soft, short shadows.
